title: rouliniella guianensis
intro: Rouliniella guianensis, commonly known as Guiana spinyhead, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, fever reduction, and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Rouliniella guianensis have been identified as iridoids and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
